messages.content: Help me execute a generic operation on an inlined object with the argument 'HelloWorld' using a specialized node `InlinableNodeInstance`, considering that the operation is bound to a specific node library `NodeLibraryInstance`, using receiver `ExportInlinedObject1Instance`?

function.name: ExportNodeTest_doGeneric
function.description: Executes a generic operation on the given receiver object with the provided argument, using a specialized inlinable node and bound to a node library. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

receiver.description: The receiver object on which the operation is performed. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

argument.description: The argument to pass to the node's execute method. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

node.description: The specialized inlinable node used for execution. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

library.description: The node library to which this operation is bound. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
